mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate directly increases discount rates for equity valuation, reducing present value of future cash flows and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of observations when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.0% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as earnings growth expectations fall.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 1% from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >1%.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 6.0% y/y) forces aggressive monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and suppressing S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of observations when CPIAUCSL exceeds 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100.0 signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment growth above 155,000 thousand persons indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of observations when PAYEMS exceeds 155,000.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and policy rates (FEDFUNDS) signal aggressive monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise as described.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1400.0 thousand units signals housing market weakness that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, driving negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 1400.0.
